home.title: Free Online Developer & QA Tools | My Toolbox
home.description: Free online tools for developers and testers: test data generator, password generator, CSV to JSON converter, JSON, SQL and YAML formatters and a diff checker.
home.h1: Free online developer and QA tools
home.lead: Ten everyday utilities for developers, testers and anyone who works with data. Everything runs in your browser, so your data stays on your device.

tools.name: Test Data Generator
tools.title: Test Data Generator – Fake JSON, CSV & SQL Data | My Toolbox
tools.description: Generate realistic fake test data online: names, emails, phones, UUIDs and more. Export as JSON, CSV, XML, HTML, SQL inserts, Python or JavaScript. Free.
tools.lead: Create realistic fake records for testing, demos and database seeding, then export them as JSON, CSV, XML, HTML, SQL inserts, Python or JavaScript.
steps: Add the columns you need and pick a data type for each one, such as full name, email, phone number, city or UUID.
Enter how many rows to generate.
Choose the output format: JSON, CSV, XML, HTML, SQL, Python or JavaScript.
Click Generate Data, then copy the result or download it as a file.

faqs.q: Is the generated data real?
faqs.aHtml: No. Every value is randomly generated fake data, so you can use it in test and demo environments without exposing real people’s details.

faqs.q: Can I create SQL INSERT statements?
faqs.aHtml: Yes. Choose SQL as the output format to get INSERT statements you can run against a local or staging database.

faqs.q: Is my data sent to a server?
faqs.aHtml: No. The data is generated in your browser and is not uploaded or stored.

tools.aboutHtml: Builds realistic fake records for testing: you define columns (row number, UUID, full/first/last name, email, phone number, city, country, random numbers, random words), pick how many rows you want, and export as JSON, CSV, XML, HTML, SQL inserts, Python or JavaScript.
goodForHtml: Seeding a local or staging database with believable users
Load and performance tests that need thousands of unique rows
Demo screens and screenshots without exposing real customer data
Unit-test fixtures in the exact language format you need
tools.tipHtml: Use synthetic data instead of copying production records. It keeps personal data out of test environments, which most privacy rules (including India's DPDP Act and the GDPR) expect.

tools.name: Random Generator
tools.title: Password Generator – Strong Random Passwords | My Toolbox
tools.description: Free strong password generator. Choose length and character sets, skip look-alike characters, and create random API keys, WPA keys and MAC addresses.
tools.lead: Generate strong random passwords and keys with your choice of length and character sets, using your browser’s cryptographically secure random number generator.
steps: Set the password length.
Choose the character sets to include: uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols.
Decide whether to allow look-alike characters such as 1, l, I, 0 and O.
Click Generate Password and copy the result. Use the key generator tab for API keys, WPA keys or MAC addresses.

faqs.q: Are these passwords secure?
faqs.aHtml: They are generated with the Web Crypto API (crypto.getRandomValues), the browser’s cryptographically secure random source, and each password includes at least one character from every set you choose.

faqs.q: How long should a password be?
faqs.aHtml: At least 16 characters for important accounts. Length adds more strength than extra symbols.

faqs.q: Do you store the passwords?
faqs.aHtml: No. Passwords are created in your browser and never sent to a server.

tools.aboutHtml: Creates strong passwords with a chosen length and character sets (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols, with an option to drop look-alike characters such as 1, l, I and 0), plus random keys for development use.
goodForHtml: A fresh password for a new account
API secrets and tokens for local development
Random identifiers for test environments
tools.tipHtml: Length beats complexity: a 16+ character password with mixed sets is far harder to guess than a short one full of symbols. Store passwords in a password manager, not in a text file.

tools.name: Data Converter
tools.title: CSV to JSON Converter – CSV, TSV, JSON & XML | My Toolbox
tools.description: Convert CSV to JSON, JSON to CSV, TSV, XML or a single column of values, in any direction. Auto-detects the input format, supports file upload. Free.
tools.h1: CSV, TSV, JSON and XML Converter
tools.lead: Convert data between CSV, TSV, JSON, XML and a single column of values in any direction, with automatic format detection and file upload.
steps: Paste your data or upload a .csv, .tsv, .json or .txt file.
Leave auto-detect on, or choose the input format yourself.
Pick the output format and, for CSV or TSV, the quote style.
Click Convert, then copy the result or download it.

faqs.q: How do I convert CSV to JSON?
faqs.aHtml: Paste the CSV with its header row, choose JSON as the output format and click Convert. Each row becomes a JSON object keyed by the header names.

faqs.q: Can it convert JSON back to CSV?
faqs.aHtml: Yes. Choose JSON as the input and CSV as the output. The JSON should be an array of objects with the same keys.

faqs.q: What happens to commas inside values?
faqs.aHtml: Quoted values such as "Doe, John" are read as one field, and values that need it are quoted again in CSV output.

tools.aboutHtml: Converts between Column (one value per line), CSV, TSV, JSON and XML, in any direction. It can auto-detect the input format, accepts a file upload, and lets you choose the quote style of CSV and TSV output.
goodForHtml: Turning a spreadsheet export (CSV) into JSON for an API or mock server
Pasting a column of values from Excel and getting a JSON array
Converting JSON API responses back into CSV for analysis
Converting an XML export into JSON, or a JSON payload into XML
tools.tipHtml: When a CSV has commas inside values, make sure those values are quoted; otherwise the columns shift. In XML, repeated elements such as <item> become rows. Check the first few converted rows before using the output.

tools.name: JavaScript Toolkit
tools.title: JavaScript Minifier & Validator Online | My Toolbox
tools.description: Minify JavaScript online with Terser, choose the ECMAScript target, and validate code for syntax errors with line numbers. Free, runs in your browser.
tools.lead: Compress JavaScript with Terser for a smaller file, or validate code and see syntax errors with their line numbers.
steps: Paste your JavaScript or upload a .js file.
Choose the ECMAScript version to target, from ES5 to the latest.
Click Compress to minify the code, or switch to Validate to check it for syntax errors.
Copy or download the minified output.

faqs.q: What does minifying JavaScript do?
faqs.aHtml: It removes whitespace and comments and shortens code so the file downloads faster, without changing what the code does.

faqs.q: Does validation run my code?
faqs.aHtml: No. The validator only parses the code to find syntax errors; it never executes it.

faqs.q: Should I edit the minified file?
faqs.aHtml: No. Keep the readable source in version control and treat the minified output as a build artifact.

tools.aboutHtml: Compresses (minifies) JavaScript, with optional variable-name mangling and compression passes, and validates code for syntax errors and likely problems.
goodForHtml: Shrinking a small script before embedding it in a page
Checking a snippet for syntax errors before deploying
Quick experiments without setting up a build tool
tools.tipHtml: Keep the original readable file in version control and treat the minified output as a build artifact. Mangling names can break code that relies on function or variable names at runtime.

tools.name: JSON Toolkit
tools.title: JSON Formatter & Validator Online | My Toolbox
tools.description: Format, beautify and validate JSON online. Find the line of a JSON error, choose 2, 4 or 8 space indents, and convert JavaScript objects to strict JSON. Free.
tools.lead: Beautify and validate JSON, find the exact line of an error, and convert JavaScript object literals into strict JSON.
steps: Paste JSON or upload a .json file. It is validated as you type.
Choose an indent of 2, 4 or 8 spaces and click Beautify.
To turn a JavaScript object with unquoted keys or single quotes into strict JSON, use Stringify.
Copy or download the formatted JSON.

faqs.q: Why is my JSON invalid?
faqs.aHtml: The most common causes are trailing commas, single quotes instead of double quotes, and unquoted keys. The error message shows where parsing failed.

faqs.q: Can it convert a JavaScript object to JSON?
faqs.aHtml: Yes. Paste an object literal such as {name: 'Ana', tags: [1, 2,]} and click Stringify. The input is parsed as data and never executed.

faqs.q: Is my JSON uploaded anywhere?
faqs.aHtml: No. Formatting and validation happen in your browser.

tools.aboutHtml: Formats, validates and beautifies JSON. It also accepts JavaScript object notation (unquoted keys), can stringify the result, and lets you choose 2, 4 or 8 spaces of indentation.
goodForHtml: Making a minified API response readable
Finding the exact spot where invalid JSON breaks
Converting a JavaScript object literal into strict JSON
tools.tipHtml: The most common JSON errors are trailing commas, single quotes instead of double quotes, and unquoted keys. The validator points to the line so you can fix it quickly.

tools.name: SQL Formatter
tools.title: SQL Formatter & Beautifier – MySQL, PostgreSQL | My Toolbox
tools.description: Format, beautify or minify SQL online for Standard SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL and T-SQL. Set keyword case and indentation, and catch syntax errors. Free.
tools.lead: Make SQL queries readable or minify them to one line, for Standard SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Transact-SQL.
steps: Paste your SQL query.
Choose the dialect: Standard SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL or Transact-SQL.
Pick UPPERCASE or lowercase keywords and an indent of 2 or 4 spaces.
Click Format to beautify, or Minify to put the query on one line, then copy the result.

faqs.q: Which SQL dialects are supported?
faqs.aHtml: Standard SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Transact-SQL (SQL Server).

faqs.q: Does minifying change my string values?
faqs.aHtml: No. Text inside quotes is kept exactly as written, and -- comments are turned into /* */ comments so they cannot hide the rest of the query.

faqs.q: Does it run the query?
faqs.aHtml: No. It only formats the text; nothing is sent to a database.

tools.aboutHtml: Beautifies or minifies SQL queries and highlights syntax errors. It supports Standard SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL and Transact-SQL (T-SQL), and can set keyword case (for example UPPERCASE).
goodForHtml: Reading a long one-line query copied from logs
Standardizing query style before a code review
Spotting a missing comma or bracket
tools.tipHtml: Pick the dialect that matches your database; functions and quoting rules differ between MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQL Server.

tools.name: Difference Checker
tools.title: Diff Checker – Compare Text Online | My Toolbox
tools.description: Compare two texts or files online and see the differences line by line, with added lines in green and removed lines in red. Free, runs in your browser.
tools.lead: Compare two blocks of text or two files and see what changed, line by line.
steps: Paste the original text on the left, or upload a file.
Paste the changed text on the right, or upload the second file.
Read the comparison below: added lines are green with a +, removed lines are red with a −.

faqs.q: Can I compare two files?
faqs.aHtml: Yes. Use Upload File above each box to load a text file into it.

faqs.q: Why does the diff show changes I did not make?
faqs.aHtml: Different whitespace or formatting counts as a change. Format both inputs the same way first, for example by beautifying both JSON files.

faqs.q: Are my files uploaded?
faqs.aHtml: No. Files are read and compared in your browser.

tools.aboutHtml: Compares two blocks of text, or two uploaded files, and shows the changes line by line: added lines in green and removed lines in red.
goodForHtml: Comparing two versions of a config file
Checking what changed between two API responses
Reviewing edits to a document or script
tools.tipHtml: Format both inputs the same way first (for example, beautify both JSON files) so the diff shows real changes instead of whitespace noise.

tools.name: Case Converter
tools.title: Case Converter – UPPER, lower & Title Case | My Toolbox
tools.description: Convert text to UPPERCASE, lowercase or Title Case online in one click, then copy the result. Free and instant, runs in your browser.
tools.lead: Change text to UPPERCASE, lowercase or Title Case in one click.
steps: Type or paste your text into the input box.
Click lowercase, UPPERCASE or Title Case.
Copy the converted text from the output box.

faqs.q: What is Title Case?
faqs.aHtml: Title Case capitalizes the first letter of every word, for example “The Quick Brown Fox”.

faqs.q: How do I fix text typed with Caps Lock on?
faqs.aHtml: Paste it in and click lowercase, or Title Case for names and headings.

faqs.q: Need camelCase or snake_case?
faqs.aHtml: Use the camelCase and snake_case converter.

tools.aboutHtml: Changes text to lowercase, UPPERCASE or Title Case, with the result in a separate output box.
goodForHtml: Fixing text typed with Caps Lock on
Making headings consistent
Normalizing lists of names or tags
tools.tipHtml: Title Case capitalizes every word; style guides differ on short words like 'of' and 'and', so review headlines before publishing.

tools.name: Text Styler
tools.title: camelCase, snake_case & kebab-case Converter | My Toolbox
tools.description: Convert text to camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case or Capitalized Case instantly for variable, function, file and URL names. Free.
tools.h1: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case and kebab-case Converter
tools.lead: Turn any phrase into programming naming styles as you type: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and Capitalized Case.
steps: Type or paste a phrase, such as “user account id”.
All five styles update as you type.
Click a result to select it, then copy it.

faqs.q: What is the difference between camelCase and PascalCase?
faqs.aHtml: camelCase starts with a lowercase letter (userAccountId); PascalCase capitalizes every word (UserAccountId).

faqs.q: When should I use snake_case or kebab-case?
faqs.aHtml: snake_case is common for Python names and database columns; kebab-case is used for URLs, CSS classes and file names.

faqs.q: Does it handle existing camelCase or acronyms?
faqs.aHtml: Yes. Input such as XMLHttpRequest userID becomes xml_http_request_user_id.

tools.aboutHtml: Converts text into programming naming styles: camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and Capitalized Case.
goodForHtml: Naming variables, functions and classes consistently
Creating URL slugs and file names (kebab-case)
Converting database column names (snake_case) to JavaScript properties (camelCase)
tools.tipHtml: Follow the convention of the language you are writing: camelCase for JavaScript variables, PascalCase for classes and React components, snake_case for Python and most SQL columns.

tools.name: YAML Validator
tools.title: YAML Validator – Check YAML Syntax Online | My Toolbox
tools.description: Validate YAML syntax online for Kubernetes manifests, Docker Compose files and CI/CD pipelines. See the error and its location instantly. Free.
tools.lead: Check YAML files for syntax errors before they break a deployment, from Kubernetes manifests to GitHub Actions workflows.
steps: Paste your YAML into the editor.
Click Validate YAML.
If there is an error, the message shows what is wrong and where; fix it and validate again.

faqs.q: Why is my YAML invalid?
faqs.aHtml: The most common causes are tab characters used for indentation, inconsistent spaces, and a missing space after a colon.

faqs.q: Can I validate Kubernetes or Docker Compose files?
faqs.aHtml: Yes. They are plain YAML, so the validator checks their syntax. It does not check them against the Kubernetes or Compose schema.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded?
faqs.aHtml: No. Validation runs in your browser.

tools.aboutHtml: Checks YAML files for syntax errors, which is useful for configuration files such as Kubernetes manifests, Docker Compose files and CI pipelines.
goodForHtml: Catching an indentation error before a deployment fails
Checking a CI/CD pipeline file
Validating Docker Compose or Kubernetes manifests
tools.tipHtml: YAML does not allow tab characters for indentation, and a single misaligned space changes the structure. Validate before committing config changes.
